command:
set -euo pipefail
DROP=/etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/20-semantic-state-cutover.conf
PARK=/var/lib/entityos/data/cutover-control/20-semantic-state-cutover.conf.pre-stage
EXPECTED=01dd25a8fddd4fc97cdbccc1852924461648811776241ffc91ba07589fb5de4d
before_pid=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
test "$(systemctl is-active entityos-vm.service)" = active
test "$(sha256sum "$DROP" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED"
sudo -n install -d -m 0700 /var/lib/entityos/data/cutover-control
sudo -n install -m 0644 "$DROP" "$PARK"
test "$(sha256sum "$PARK" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$EXPECTED"
sudo -n mv "$DROP" "$DROP.pre-stage-disabled"
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
after_pid=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
test "$after_pid" = "$before_pid"
test "$(systemctl is-active entityos-vm.service)" = active
show=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p DropInPaths -p ExecCondition -p ExecStopPost --no-pager)
printf '%s\n' "$show"
printf '%s\n' "$show" | grep -Fq '10-volatile-state-guard.conf'
printf '%s\n' "$show" | grep -Fq '/usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh'
if printf '%s\n' "$show" | grep -Fq '20-semantic-state-cutover.conf'; then echo '20 still effective' >&2; exit 21; fi
if printf '%s\n' "$show" | grep -Eq '^ExecStopPost=.'; then echo 'ExecStopPost not empty' >&2; exit 22; fi
echo OMEGA_CUTOVER_HOLDING_PHASE_READY=1
echo MAINPID=$after_pid
echo PARK_SHA=$EXPECTED
